title: Close the independent delivery-audit findings: Release Gate Sonar debt, tenant lifecycle contract deviations, cross-tenant error shaping, and stale consumer docs
goal: An independent delivery audit (2026-10-22) of main 92b94474 found no P0 and no unresolved P1, but left four classes of debt: (1) Release Gate is red with 8 unresolved SonarCloud issues introduced by #407, so no release can be cut from main; (2) two tenant-lifecycle invariants from TENANT_CONTRACT_V1 are not enforced (the last owner can be removed, an archived tenant can return to active); (3) cross-tenant user read/update by id answers 500 instead of 404/403, and a reserved-role-key conflict answers envelope code 500; (4) consumer-facing docs disagree with the code (README/CHANGELOG still name v0.16.1, TENANT_API documents an unmounted route group, the scope matrix calls the runtime single-tenant, the deployment guide never mentions tenant_mode). This packet closes all of it, records the evidence, and prepares (but does not publish) v0.17.1.
findings: A1 (P2, blocking release): Release Gate on main 92b94474 failed (run 39733491324) with 'Release blocked: 8 unresolved SonarCloud issue(s)'. The eight: go:S1192 x2 and go:S3776 x1 in backend/modules/system/iam/tenant/tenant_provision.go; typescript:S3776 in frontend/src/core/layout/useLayoutMenu.tsx; typescript:S6759 x3 in PlanFeatureGuard.tsx (two components) and TenantPlanMatrix.tsx; typescript:S6582 in frontend/src/store/useTenantSessionStore.ts.

B1 (P2): Service.RemoveMember deletes a membership without checking the tenant's last active owner, while contract TENANT_CONTRACT_V1 §2.2 requires at least one owner on every non-archived tenant. AddMember already refuses to demote an owner, so the delete path is the only hole.
B2 (P2): UpdateTenant only validates the status enum; an archived tenant can be written back to active, but contract §2.1 declares archived terminal and irreversible.

B3 (P2): Cross-tenant user read/update by id returns envelope code 500 (user.detail.error / user.update.error) instead of 404/403. No data leaks (verified against a real second tenant) but contract §5 requires not distinguishing missing from foreign, and the role-member endpoint already answers 404.
B4 (P3): A role-key conflict (role.key.reserved) answers envelope code 500 even though pkg/common.CodeForError maps ErrConflict to 400; the role handler bypasses the helper.

C1 (P2): README.md, README.en.md and the README changelog link still name v0.16.1 as the current foundation release while VERSION is 0.17.0 and v0.17.0 is published, so a consumer following the README pins a version that lacks the three P1 fixes shipped after it.
C2 (P2): docs/api/TENANT_API.md documents /api/v1/tenants* but tenant.RegisterRoutes has no call site; the mounted surface is /api/v1/system/tenant* behind PlatformCapabilityMiddleware.
C3 (P2): docs/designs/TENANT_RESOURCE_SCOPE_MATRIX.md (and .en.md) still state 'the current runtime is single-tenant', contradicting the delivered multi-tenant capability and the contract.
C4 (P2): docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md contains zero mentions of tenant_mode/multi, so an operator cannot learn from the deployment guide that multi exists, is one-way, or needs a platform subject.

C5 (P3): .harness/STATUS.md claims 'no known P0-P3 residue' and 'open issues 0' while Release Gate is red on main, and two task packets (2026-10-12-flake-signal-remediation, 2026-10-12-foundation-release-asset-gate) stayed in-progress although their acceptance criteria were met.

acceptanceCriteria: The eight SonarCloud rules flagged on 92b94474 are addressed in code (duplicate literals extracted, cognitive complexity reduced, props read-only, optional chain preferred) without adding suppressions.
Removing the last active owner of a non-archived tenant is refused with a stable error key and covered by a real-MySQL test.
archived -> active is refused; active <-> suspended and -> archived remain allowed, with a table-driven test.
Cross-tenant user read/update answers 404 (same as a genuinely missing id) and writes nothing; covered by a real-MySQL test.
Role-key conflicts answer envelope code 400 through common.CodeForError.

README (zh/en), CHANGELOG and RELEASE_NOTES state the same current version; TENANT_API documents the mounted /system/tenant surface and its platform-only boundary; the scope matrix no longer calls the runtime single-tenant; DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE documents tenant_mode.
STATUS records the audit verdict and the residual items; the two stale in-progress packets are closed with evidence references.

go build ./..., go vet ./..., go test ./... (real MySQL + Redis, PANTHEON_TEST_DSN_REQUIRED=true) pass; frontend tsc/eslint/vitest/prebuild/vite build pass; task-packet, docs-frontmatter and duplication checkers pass.

doNotTouch: dist/** and the published v0.17.0 release assets

implementationNotes: The two duplicate literals in tenant_provision.go become named constants; the complexity comes from repairTenantPlatformGrants, so the platform-only menu collection and the two grant deletions move into helpers with the same SQL.

The last-owner guard runs inside RemoveMember before the delete, counts active owners for the tenant, and only refuses when the target row is the last owner; removal of a non-owner or of one of several owners is unchanged.
Status transitions use a pure helper so the rule is testable without a database; the existing session-revocation decision is untouched.
User not-found paths wrap the gorm error in common.ErrNotFound; the handler then maps it through common.CodeForError so a foreign id and a missing id answer the same 404.

Frontend fixes are mechanical: Readonly<Props> on the three components, optional chaining in isTenantScopedSession, and capability/short-circuit extraction in filterMenuTreeByCapabilities to drop cognitive complexity below 15.
Docs state the mounted surface and the boundary first, then point at the contract for detail; no new normative rule is introduced.
v0.17.1 is prepared but not published: tag creation and asset upload stay a maintainer action.
